data.name: InstallHint
data.value: Install the 64-bit DM8 client from Dameng (eco.dameng.com), which registers the ODBC driver, or name another installed driver with the odbcDriver option.

data.name: NoSourcePrivilege
data.value: Dameng returned no source for {0}; the login may lack the privilege to read it.

data.name: NotASessionId
data.value: "{0}" is not a Dameng session id.
data.comment: {0} is the value given as a session id.

data.name: SslPathRequired
data.value: Dameng encrypts with client certificates: set the SSL_PATH option to the directory holding them (and SSL_PWD if they are protected).

data.name: VerifyIdentityUnsupported
data.value: Dameng's TLS checks the server certificate against the CA in SSL_PATH but never matches it to the host name. Choose Verify CA, or use an SSH tunnel.
